rationale: Dataset reconnaissance requires comprehensive profiling of structure, identifiers, temporal coverage, and joins. Load and schema components establish baseline structure and produce data_contract.json. Missingness with all_columns scope reveals entirely-empty columns (dx3–5, modifiers, denial codes in medical claims) indicating data quality issues. Duplicate_check verifies all candidate keys including the composite adherence key (member_id + therapeutic_class). Date_ranges with consistency_checks=true detects temporal anomalies such as enrollment_end uniformity and service/adjudication date ordering violations. Join_check across all six relationships exposes the critical pharmacy-provider mismatches (pharmacy_npi and prescriber_npi show 0% match rate to providers table). Report with cite_artifacts=true produces reproducible documentation linking every finding to source artifacts.
